title: The Green Function for Elliptic Systems in the Upper-Half Space
summary: Let $L$ be a second-order, homogeneous, constant (complex) coefficient elliptic system in ${\mathbb{R}}^n$. The goal of this article is provide a qualitative and quantitative study of the nature of the Green function associated with the system $L$ in the upper-half space. Starting with a definition of the Green function which brings forth the minimal features which identify this object uniquely, we establish optimal nontangential maximal function estimates and regularity results up to the boundary for the said Green function.
